newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares dragged to lower close by Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares dragged to lower close by Astra.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Wednesday, depressed by a fall in drugs major Astra.
The exchange's general index fell 0.53 percent to 2,637.65 in light turnover of 2.96 billion crowns.
"This is a completly trendless market where the little trading that actually is done is customer related," a trader said.
"We'll see (if there's a change) at the end of the week when Norscan (North American Scandinavian pulp stocks) and U.S. retail sales figures are released."
Astra dropped eight crowns to 341.5 after its U.S. partner Merck fell on being downgraded by several brokerages.
"Several U.S. firms have downgraded Merck and this weighs on the Astra share," a chief trader said.
Telecoms group Ericsson also slid in the afternoon and ended four crowns lower at 250 crowns.
Vehicle maker Volvo edged up 0.5 crown to 191 after announcing a closer cooperation with Mitsubishi Motors Corp at their joint venture car plant, NedCar, in the Netherlands.
